llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究高熵合金与金属玻璃复合材料的选区激光熔化制备，未涉及生物医学植入物相关的多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants; it is focused on metallic glass reinforcement of HEA for general structural applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过添加金属玻璃提高高熵合金力学性能
summary_zh.method: 选区激光熔化制备不同金属玻璃含量的AlCoCrFeNi复合材料
summary_zh.result: 金属玻璃添加显著增强合金强度与塑性
summary_zh.validation: 压缩/拉伸力学测试验证性能

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical properties of AlCoCrFeNi high entropy alloy by incorporating Fe-based metallic glass via selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: AlCoCrFeNi high entropy alloy powders were mixed with varying contents of Fe-based metallic glass and fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: The addition of metallic glass improved both strength and ductility of the high entropy alloy composites.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through quasi-static compression and tensile tests.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钢涂层的耐磨性，与生物医学植入物无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on wear-resistant steel coatings for industrial applications, with no biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, and no osseointegration or fatigue testing for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高钢涂层的耐磨性，探索SLM工艺的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备硼化物增强钢涂层，并进行微观表征和磨损测试。
summary_zh.result: SLM工艺参数影响涂层微观结构和耐磨性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过磨损试验和微观分析验证了涂层的耐磨性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve wear resistance of steel coatings by investigating the effect of Selective Laser Melting process parameters.
summary_en.method: Boride-reinforced steel coatings were fabricated via Selective Laser Melting, followed by microstructural characterization and wear testing.
summary_en.result: The SLM parameters significantly influence the microstructure and wear resistance of the coatings.
summary_en.validation: Wear resistance was validated through tribological tests and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: Biomimetic double network hydrogels: Combining dynamic and static crosslinks to enable biofabrication and control cell‐matrix interactions
papers.abstract: Abstract Hydrogels are promising candidates for recapitulation of the native extracellular matrix (ECM), yet recreating molecular and spatiotemporal complexity within a single network remains a challenge. Double network (DN) hydrogels are a promising step towards recapitulating the multicomponent ECM and have enhanced mechanical properties. Here, we investigate DNs based on dynamic covalent and covalent bonds to mimic the dynamicity of the ECM and enable biofabrication. We also investigate the spatiotemporal molecular attachment of a bioactive adhesive peptide within the networks. Using oxidized alginate (dynamic network, Schiff base) and polyethylene glycol diacrylate (static network, acrylate polymerization) we find an optimized procedure, where the dynamic network is formed first, followed by the static network. This initial dynamically cross‐linked hydrogel imparts self‐healing, injectability, and 3D printability, while the subsequent DN hydrogel improves the stability of the 3D gels and imparts toughness. Rheology and compression testing show that the toughening is due to the combination of energy dissipation (dynamic network) and elasticity (static network). Furthermore, where we place adhesive sites in the network matters; we find distinct differences when an adhesive peptide, Arg‐Gly‐Asp (RGD), is attached to the different networks. This DN strategy bring us closer to understanding and recreating the complex multicomponent ECM—pushing us past a materials view of cell adhesion—while enabling injectabiltiy and printing of tough hydrogels.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文涉及生物墨水配方和打印性能，但未使用人工智能技术，仅提供材料背景。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration into any bioprinting workflow stage; purely material development without data-driven methods or autonomous decision.

summary_zh.motivation: 模拟天然细胞外基质的复杂性和动态性
summary_zh.method: 构建动态-静态双重网络水凝胶，优化交联顺序实现可打印性和韧性
summary_zh.result: 动态网络提供自愈合和打印性，静态网络增强稳定性，RGD肽位置影响细胞黏附
summary_zh.validation: 流变学、压缩测试和3D打印验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To mimic the molecular and spatiotemporal complexity of the native extracellular matrix using double network hydrogels.
summary_en.method: Double network hydrogels combining dynamic Schiff base (oxidized alginate) and static acrylate (PEGDA) crosslinks were fabricated with optimized sequential formation.
summary_en.result: The dynamic network imparts self-healing and printability, while the static network provides stability and toughness; adhesive peptide placement in different networks yields distinct cell adhesion responses.
summary_en.validation: Rheological measurements, compression testing, and 3D printing experiments confirmed the mechanical properties and printability.
